tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background in every app. Warm cream by day, plum night by dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, bottom nav, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Burrow habitat sky (history, search), meter tracks, wells, pressed rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and the backdrop dot pattern. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, surface and surface-sunk (12.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, input borders, inactive nav labels on paper, surface and surface-sunk (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The sticker outline (2px) around buttons, chips, meters and the characters, and the hard sticker shadow.

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Makan's home colour (Bao's app); the default accent. Fill only: put on-accent text on it.

tokens.name: tomato-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backdrop band and selected-chip fill for makan. ink text on it.

tokens.name: tomato-text
tokens.usage: Warning words: over budget, over calorie target. On paper, surface and surface-sunk (4.6:1 or better). Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: sunny
tokens.usage: Sunflowers (open petals of the makan ring), the sun, celebration accents, carbs data colour. Fill only, on-accent text.

tokens.name: sunny-soft
tokens.usage: Meadow habitat sky (makan headers), closed petals of the sunflower ring, highlight wash. ink text on it.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Money's home colour (Kacang's app), oak leaves, the lit leaves of the wreath ring; fat data colour. Fill only, on-accent text.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Oak habitat sky (money headers), unlit wreath leaves, Stash background, selected-chip fill for money. ink text on it.

tokens.name: mint-text
tokens.usage: Money in (income, refunds), always with a + sign. On paper, surface and surface-sunk (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Protein data colour, info accents, the worried bun's sweat drop. Fill only.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: River habitat sky (settings headers), World sky, info banners. ink text on it.

tokens.name: sky-text
tokens.usage: Links and the focus ring. On paper, surface and surface-sunk (4.4:1 or better; ring needs 3:1).

tokens.name: bubblegum
tokens.usage: Character cheeks. Never UI meaning.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The current app's home colour: primary buttons, active nav, ring fill. Each app re-points it (makan: tomato, money: mint).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The current app's tint: header wave, selected chips. Re-pointed with accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, tomato, mint, sunny and sky fills (5.2:1 or better). Never white.

tokens.name: protein
tokens.usage: Protein in macro meters and charts. Always labelled.

tokens.name: carbs
tokens.usage: Carbs in macro meters and charts. Always labelled.

tokens.name: fat
tokens.usage: Fat in macro meters and charts. Always labelled.

tokens.name: grass
tokens.usage: Ground of the meadow and oak habitats, grass fringe on soil. Decorative; never behind text.

tokens.name: soil
tokens.usage: Underground bands: burrow habitat ground, Stash, the Tunnel rail, the World's lower layer. Decorative; never behind text.

tokens.name: soil-deep
tokens.usage: Tunnels, chambers and holes dug into soil. Chamber labels sit on it in fixed cream #fff4e2 (6.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The river habitat and World river. Decorative; never behind text.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Tree trunks and branches in habitats, the wreath ring's branch; matches the twig and log traces.

tokens.name: fur-hamster
tokens.usage: Bao's fur. Peek paws and any Bao-coloured tile. Same in both themes: the animals are stickers.

tokens.name: fur-squirrel
tokens.usage: Kacang's fur.

tokens.name: skin-molerat
tokens.usage: Gali's skin.

tokens.name: fur-beaver
tokens.usage: Kayu's fur.

families.display: Fredoka, "Avenir Next Rounded", "SF Pro Rounded", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: hero-number
styles.usage: The one big number on a home screen (kcal left, spent this month). Use tabular figures.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and section headings, sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, list row titles, inputs (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Amounts and values in list rows, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Meter labels, chips, nav labels, axis labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, meter label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding, gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room, top of hero.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, icon tiles, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List groups, sheets' inner blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and bottom sheets. The signature soft corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, meters, the bottom nav.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Hard offset under primary buttons, FAB and chips. Pressing removes it (the button moves down 3px).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Cards floating over a backdrop pattern, bottom sheets, the bottom nav.

tokens.name: border-sticker
tokens.usage: Outline width for buttons, chips, meters, nav and icon tiles.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges using line.
